name: Aira Come Home
source:
Welcome to Enstarrie High School!

After seeing a show the previous year, you've finally been admitted into the high school of your dreams! However, things quickly turn in a strange direction when you see Aira Shiratori being harassed by a group of bullies. How will your first day go? Will you get along with Aira? What other secrets about him, his friends, and his enemies will reveal themselves? Find out for yourself!

[From [url=https://airacomehome.itch.io/aira-come-home-chapter-one]Itch.io[/url]]

This visual novel was made based on characters and a few plot moments from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ensemble_Stars!]Ensemble Stars![/url] series of anime and games, intended as a re-imagining of the original canon.
There is no need to know how the original story plays out, but there could be some minor spoilers.
translation:
欢迎来到Enstarrie高中！

去年看过一场演出后，你终于考进了梦寐以求的高中！然而，当你看见白鸟蓝良遭一群霸凌者骚扰时，事情很快朝奇怪的方向发展。你的第一天会过得如何？你和蓝良能相处融洽吗？关于他、朋友和敌人的其他秘密又会逐渐揭晓什么？亲自来一探究竟吧！

[来源：[url=https://airacomehome.itch.io/aira-come-home-chapter-one]Itch.io[/url]]

本作以动画及游戏系列[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ensemble_Stars!]《偶像梦幻祭》[/url]中的角色与部分剧情为基础，重新演绎原作设定。
不必了解原作剧情也能游玩，但可能会遇到少量剧透。
